item.description: Pre-populated API test suite for role **System Manager** (81 authorized endpoints).

request.description:
**Function:** `agency_tracking.auth_api.get_csrf_token`

**Purpose:** Execute get_csrf_token

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.auth_api.get_current_user`

**Purpose:** allow_guest=True deliberately, with an explicit Guest check inside — not a security
relaxation. Without it, an anonymous SPA's "is there already a session?" bootstrap check
(needed so a page refresh doesn't force a fresh login) hits Frappe's own whitelist guard
before this function's body ever runs, producing a 403 on every single cold page load.
Returning None for Guest instead of throwing means that bootstrap check is a normal 200
response either way — "nobody's logged in" is an expected outcome, not an error.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.cancel_applicant`

**Purpose:** Global 'Cancelled' escape hatch (2026-08-29 lifecycle spec): only from Registered/CV
Generated (never Draft -- nothing committed yet to cancel). If there's an active Placement,
freeze it and its Clearance Steps first (marked Cancelled, left as permanent history) and
clear active_placement -- all before the Applicant itself moves to Cancelled, so
Placement.validate()'s own checks (still-matching active_placement/status) pass cleanly.
Landing on Cancelled never bumps cycle_number by itself; only a later restart does.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.create_applicant`

**Purpose:** Open a new Applicant file at Draft. Registrar, Manager, Admin only
(doctype-level create permission, Part G).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.get_applicant`

**Purpose:** Execute get_applicant

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.list_applicants`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Applicant never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Applicant, which only Registrar/Manager/Admin/System Manager
could read (Applicant's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role that legitimately
needs to resolve an applicant name reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint
Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only access on
the doctype itself, see applicant.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions the same
way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.list_country_bans`

**Purpose:** Execute list_country_bans

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.log_applicant_fee`

**Purpose:** Manual 'Log Fee' button path. Just flips fee_status to Paid and saves -- the actual
ledger-entry creation lives in Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction (before_save), so a
direct Desk edit that sets fee_status=Paid gets identical behavior without going through
this endpoint at all. Kept as its own whitelisted call (rather than folding into
update_applicant) so the button can carry its own explicit permission + friendly
already-logged error, matching the other single-purpose action endpoints in this module.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.register_applicant`

**Purpose:** Move an Applicant from Draft to Registered via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part A.2 Stage 2). Field-floor and medical-FIT checks run inside Applicant.validate(),
triggered by transition()'s doc.save().

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.remove_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Delete permission on Applicant Country Ban is Manager/Admin/System Manager only (per
doctype permissions) -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.restart_applicant`

**Purpose:** Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically (lands on
Draft/Registered coming from Cancelled -- state_machine.bump_cycle_number). Restarting
straight to Registered fails naturally via the normal ValidationError from
Applicant.validate() if the field floor isn't actually satisfied by existing data --
retry with target_status="Draft" instead, no special-casing needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.set_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Whitelisted create surface for Applicant Country Ban (backend-issues #08) -- the doctype
previously had no whitelisted writer anywhere, so the only way to set a ban was the raw
/api/resource/Applicant Country Ban endpoint, contradicting the "no raw /api/resource/*
exposure" architecture rule. Doctype permissions already grant create to Registrar/
Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager, so this just wraps a normal insert() and
lets Frappe's own permission check do the gating.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant`

**Purpose:** Edit an Applicant still at Draft or Registered. Does not change status — use
register_applicant for that transition.

Two special cases handled here rather than in Applicant.validate() (both need to run
*before* the normal update, and the entry_track one needs its own transition() call --
see CLAUDE.md's absolute "no doc.status = X; doc.save()" rule, state_machine.py):

1. entry_track changing while Registered/CV Generated forces a regression to Draft first
   (old track still in place, so the lenient Draft floor trivially passes), *then* the rest
   of the update (including the new entry_track) applies normally. cycle_number bumps
   automatically via state_machine.bump_cycle_number.
2. destination_country being set/changed is checked against Applicant Country Ban.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant_for_lmis`

**Purpose:** Narrow LMIS-stage edit surface (2026-08-29 correction, Part 5): national_id, labor_id,
and emergency_contact_* are deliberately NOT part of the Registered field floor -- they're
captured here, once the candidate is actually at the LMIS clearance step, not guessed at
registration time. Restricted to the two LMIS roles (plus Manager/Admin, same fallback
pattern as everywhere else) rather than general update_applicant.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.cv_api.generate_cv`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 3 / Part I Step 2: create + submit a CV Record for a Standard-track
Applicant, then move the Applicant to CV Generated. CV Record.validate() enforces the
Standard-only/Registered-status rules first (clearer, CV-specific error messages);
transition()'s own gate re-checks the same invariant as a backstop. The Musaned gate and
the musaned_status field were both removed 2026-08-29 -- Musaned tracking is gone from
this system entirely. Also renders and attaches the actual CV PDF (2026-08-29) --
previously this just created a bare record with no document output at all.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.list_my_wakala_requests`

**Purpose:** New (2026-08-29): a Contractor-scoped list of every unpaid Wakala-bearing Embassy step
for their own placements — the page the watchdog/manual reminders (watchdogs.
wakala_reminder_watchdog) are actually pointing them at. Mirrors list_my_clearance_steps()'s
pattern for the internal-staff side.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.list_portal_candidates`

**Purpose:** Part G: an agency sees only its own destination country's catalog — Standard-track
candidates that are CV Generated and not yet locked by anyone (active_placement empty).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.select_candidate`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 4: atomic, globally exclusive selection. The instant one agency selects
a candidate, they vanish from every other agency's view — enforced here with a row lock
(SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so two concurrent selections can't both see the candidate as free.

free_replacement_for_complaint (Part A.4, Step 10): a worker who returned within the
3-month window entitles the same contractor to one free replacement selection. The
replacement "goes through the exact same journey from Stage 4 onward as any newly selected
candidate" (business-workflow-srs.md) — i.e. this same function — just flagged so
finance_engine.accrue_commission() skips billing for it.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.advance_placement`

**Purpose:** Move a Placement forward through its lifecycle via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part C). Passing override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked
(business-workflow-srs.md: "always with a written reason") — transition() itself enforces
the Manager/Admin role check and that the reason is non-empty.

This is the direct/manual path. The real auto-chain (LMIS -> Ticketing -> Departure,
corridor-completion gating Processing -> Stamped) is Step 7, once Clearance Step exists to
drive and gate against.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.create_muayena_placement`

**Purpose:** Muayena track (Part A.1 / Part I Step 4): "enters directly at Selected with contract in
hand" — no portal, no CV. Internal staff (Registrar/Manager/Admin/Contract Parser) only —
a Muayena candidate is matched to an agency directly, not through the public portal.

2026-08-29 correction: destination_country is no longer a parameter here. It used to be
set as a side effect of this call (the old assumption was that Muayena's destination
becomes known only once a contract names it); that was wrong — it's selected during
Draft/Registered same as Standard, and is now part of MUAYENA_REGISTERED_REQUIRED_FIELDS.
The contractor is always picked manually for Muayena (both countries) — Saudi's contract
*can* carry a labeled agency name/license for cross-checking, but auto-assignment isn't
attempted at creation time either way; Kuwait's contract never carries one at all.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.list_placements`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Placement never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Placement, which only Manager/Admin/System Manager/Contract
Parser/Ticketer could read (Placement's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role
that legitimately needs to resolve a placement reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer,
Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only
access on the doctype itself, see placement.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions
the same way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.parse_contract_file`

**Purpose:** Given a Frappe file_url for an uploaded contract, returns a dict of Placement field updates.
Extracts contract_signed_date, and country-specific structured fields.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.parse_visa_file`

**Purpose:** Kuwait visa document parser for placement_api.upload_visa.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_predeparture_medical_result`

**Purpose:** Pre-departure medical checkpoint (~72h before flight, Part A.2 Stage 8 / Step 6): gates
Ticketed -> Departed (see state_machine.medical_2_gate). Mirrors
record_selected_medical_result's shape -- FIT just records the result and lets
advance_placement(new_status="Departed") pass the gate; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant +
Placement via the same cascade, since a failed pre-departure medical this late (ticket
already purchased) has no forward path either, same as the earlier Selected-stage check.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_reschedule`

**Purpose:** Ticketer role. reschedule_cost is only meaningful/loggable when cause is Internal --
an airline/airport-caused reschedule isn't billed to us.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_selected_medical_result`

**Purpose:** New post-contract medical checkpoint (2026-08-29): gates Selected -> Processing (see
state_machine.medical_selected_gate). FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole
Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as applicant_api.cancel_applicant, uniformly
for every track/country -- nothing forward from here.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_ticket_details`

**Purpose:** Ticketer role. ticket_cost (if given) auto-logs a Pending Applicant Transaction expense
-- same pattern as clearance-step payments, everything money-related feeds the one Finance
ledger.

2026-08-30 fix (backend-issues #05): ticket_number/flight_date are pure logistics fields with
no FX dependency -- the cost-logging sub-step now runs inside its own DB savepoint, so a
missing FX rate for `currency` only unwinds the failed expense insert, not the ticket fields
saved just above (which is the doc.save() call still pending in the same transaction, same
as it always was -- only the failure boundary changed). The cost log is best-effort from
here on: failure is reported back to the caller as a warning, not a fatal error for the
whole call.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.upload_contract`

**Purpose:** Standard track (Part I Step 4): attach the signed contract to an already-selected
Placement (created by portal_api.select_candidate in Step 3) and extract contract_signed_date
plus, per destination_country, the structured fields contract_parser.parse_contract_file
knows how to pull out (Saudi: contract#/visa#/employer/agency; Kuwait: employer/site/
duration/salary only -- its template carries far less). Either the contractor who made the
selection, or internal staff (Contract Parser and the general fallback roles), may upload.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.upload_visa`

**Purpose:** Kuwait only: a separate document from the contract, uploaded alongside it. Carries
visa_number/type/dates plus the agency name/license the Kuwait contract itself never has.
Cross-checks the parsed agency identity against this Placement's actual Contractor and
flags a mismatch (notify, never auto-reassigns).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.complete_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Mark a Clearance Step complete/Issued. Not for Embassy steps -- use
submit_embassy_step/stamp_embassy_step/reject_embassy_step instead.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.list_my_clearance_steps`

**Purpose:** A Clearance Officer / Ticketer's own ToDo-scoped queue, or -- for the six country+step
roles -- every row of their matching step_type. Driven entirely by the same permission
scoping as direct doctype access (Clearance Step's get_permission_query_conditions), so
this and a raw list call return the same rows.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.reassign_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Part A.2: "reassignable by a manager if needed" — the escape hatch for the default
auto-chain.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.reject_embassy_step`

**Purpose:** Documents returned rejected (Thursday) -- requires a written remark
(Clearance Step.validate() also enforces this as a backstop).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.stamp_embassy_step`

**Purpose:** Documents returned stamped (Thursday) -- the success outcome.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.start_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Execute start_clearance_step

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.submit_embassy_step`

**Purpose:** Documents submitted (Monday). Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.approve_transaction`

**Purpose:** Finance Manager/Admin only. Moves Pending -> Approved via the sanctioned transition()
path -- only Approved entries count toward ledger/balance totals (Part D).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.create_commission_batch`

**Purpose:** Manual batching path (Part D: "both paths converge on one create_batch_request()
function" — the other path is the automatic one inside finance_engine.accrue_commission).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.get_batch_invoice_pdf`

**Purpose:** AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): on-demand PDF (applicant names + amounts),
built fresh whenever requested, not pre-generated/stored at batch creation.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.get_fx_rate`

**Purpose:** Execute get_fx_rate

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.get_owed_commissions`

**Purpose:** Execute get_owed_commissions

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.log_stage_expense`

**Purpose:** Execute log_stage_expense

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.log_stage_income`

**Purpose:** Execute log_stage_income

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.reject_transaction`

**Purpose:** Finance Manager/Admin only, mandatory reason. Pending -> Rejected; never counts toward
the ledger.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.set_fx_rate`

**Purpose:** Execute set_fx_rate

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.settle_batch`

**Purpose:** Execute settle_batch

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.settle_batch_items`

**Purpose:** AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): explicit multi-select manual settlement,
alongside upload_batch_payment_proof's best-effort parser -- marks specific Commission
Batch Item child rows Paid and syncs each affected batch's status (Partially Settled until
every item is Paid, then Settled).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.trigger_early_commission_accrual`

**Purpose:** Part D: "Manual early-trigger (idempotency-guarded either way)" — for cases needing to
bill sooner than Departed. Same accrue_commission() as the automatic path, so calling this
and then later reaching Departed naturally is a no-op the second time.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.upload_batch_payment_proof`

**Purpose:** AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): parses a CSV or PDF listing paid applicant
names (best-effort), fuzzy-matches against this batch's own item list, marks matched items
Paid. Unmatched names stay Pending for manual settle_batch_items review -- never blocks.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.void_transaction`

**Purpose:** No hard delete, ever (addendum). Finance Manager/Admin only, mandatory reason. Only
legal from Approved (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS enforces this — transition() itself rejects
voiding a Pending/Rejected row). Routed through transition() like every other status
change (never doc.status = X; doc.save() directly) -- the row stays visible with its
status flagged and a Process Event on the audit trail, never disappears.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.reconciliation_api.manually_match_line`

**Purpose:** Escape hatch for lines the automatic matcher couldn't confidently resolve (ambiguous
amount collisions, missing reference text) — Finance Manager/Admin only, same shape as
every other manual-override path in this build.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.reconciliation_api.upload_bank_statement`

**Purpose:** Execute upload_bank_statement

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.acknowledge_complaint`

**Purpose:** New -> Unresolved.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.create_complaint`

**Purpose:** business-workflow-srs.md Part 5: "Foreign agencies (or occasionally internal staff on
their behalf) can log a complaint against any worker." An agency can only complain about
their own placement; internal staff need some recognized staff role, but creation itself
isn't restricted the way resolution is.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.list_unresolved_complaints`

**Purpose:** business-workflow-srs.md Part 5: "sorted oldest-first so nothing quietly sits forgotten
at the bottom of a list."

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.resolve_complaint`

**Purpose:** Master spec Part A.5: "Only Complaint Manager and Admin can move resolution status."
Dismissed requires a written reason — enforced both here (clear error before the doctype
validate() would also catch it) and in Complaint.validate() as a defense-in-depth backstop.

override_reason (Manager Override, e.g. approving a free replacement outside the normal
3-month window in an exceptional case): overriding a gate is a Manager-level power
throughout this build (transition() itself enforces Manager/Admin for any override), so
the permission check here widens to include plain Manager specifically for an override
attempt — an ordinary (non-override) resolution move stays Complaint Manager/Admin only,
per Part A.5's literal statement.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.add_participant`

**Purpose:** addendum: "adding participants to an agency thread stays restricted" — enforced here as
an outright block for Agency threads (their shape is fixed at exactly two participants,
Chat Thread.validate() also enforces this). Internal threads can grow freely between staff.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.create_agency_thread`

**Purpose:** Foreign Agency opens their support thread (no params needed).
Admin, Manager, and Communication Manager can also pass `contractor` (Contractor name or user email)
to open/create a thread with that agency directly.

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.create_internal_thread`

**Purpose:** Internal staff only — "internal chat is open between all staff, no role restriction,"
but never a route into an agency's thread (validate_thread_participants blocks a Foreign
Agency target here just as it blocks one as the requester elsewhere).

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.get_thread_messages`

**Purpose:** Execute get_thread_messages

**Active Role Context:** `System Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.list_threads`

**Purpose:** addendum: "Agencies cannot know other agencies exist... this needs an explicit test,

times are computed from Process Event transitions that happened within from_date/to_date,

**Function:** `agency_tracking.report_api.get_placement_aging_report`

**Purpose:** Admin/Manager: two buckets, both sorted worst-first (highest priority). Distinct from
the existing contract_age_watchdog push notification -- this is a pull/list view, same
pattern as get_complaint_aging_report.

given period." Grouped by whoever actually did the work (CV Record.generated_by,
Clearance Step.completed_by, Process Event.actor for placement-stage transitions) —
deliberately not attempting to attribute "medicals processed" per staff member, since

**Function:** `agency_tracking.auth_api.get_csrf_token`

**Purpose:** Execute get_csrf_token

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.auth_api.get_current_user`

**Purpose:** allow_guest=True deliberately, with an explicit Guest check inside — not a security
relaxation. Without it, an anonymous SPA's "is there already a session?" bootstrap check
(needed so a page refresh doesn't force a fresh login) hits Frappe's own whitelist guard
before this function's body ever runs, producing a 403 on every single cold page load.
Returning None for Guest instead of throwing means that bootstrap check is a normal 200
response either way — "nobody's logged in" is an expected outcome, not an error.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.cancel_applicant`

**Purpose:** Global 'Cancelled' escape hatch (2026-08-29 lifecycle spec): only from Registered/CV
Generated (never Draft -- nothing committed yet to cancel). If there's an active Placement,
freeze it and its Clearance Steps first (marked Cancelled, left as permanent history) and
clear active_placement -- all before the Applicant itself moves to Cancelled, so
Placement.validate()'s own checks (still-matching active_placement/status) pass cleanly.
Landing on Cancelled never bumps cycle_number by itself; only a later restart does.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.create_applicant`

**Purpose:** Open a new Applicant file at Draft. Registrar, Manager, Admin only
(doctype-level create permission, Part G).

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.get_applicant`

**Purpose:** Execute get_applicant

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.list_applicants`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Applicant never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Applicant, which only Registrar/Manager/Admin/System Manager
could read (Applicant's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role that legitimately
needs to resolve an applicant name reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint
Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only access on
the doctype itself, see applicant.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions the same
way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.list_country_bans`

**Purpose:** Execute list_country_bans

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.log_applicant_fee`

**Purpose:** Manual 'Log Fee' button path. Just flips fee_status to Paid and saves -- the actual
ledger-entry creation lives in Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction (before_save), so a
direct Desk edit that sets fee_status=Paid gets identical behavior without going through
this endpoint at all. Kept as its own whitelisted call (rather than folding into
update_applicant) so the button can carry its own explicit permission + friendly
already-logged error, matching the other single-purpose action endpoints in this module.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.register_applicant`

**Purpose:** Move an Applicant from Draft to Registered via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part A.2 Stage 2). Field-floor and medical-FIT checks run inside Applicant.validate(),
triggered by transition()'s doc.save().

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.remove_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Delete permission on Applicant Country Ban is Manager/Admin/System Manager only (per
doctype permissions) -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.restart_applicant`

**Purpose:** Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically (lands on
Draft/Registered coming from Cancelled -- state_machine.bump_cycle_number). Restarting
straight to Registered fails naturally via the normal ValidationError from
Applicant.validate() if the field floor isn't actually satisfied by existing data --
retry with target_status="Draft" instead, no special-casing needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.set_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Whitelisted create surface for Applicant Country Ban (backend-issues #08) -- the doctype
previously had no whitelisted writer anywhere, so the only way to set a ban was the raw
/api/resource/Applicant Country Ban endpoint, contradicting the "no raw /api/resource/*
exposure" architecture rule. Doctype permissions already grant create to Registrar/
Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager, so this just wraps a normal insert() and
lets Frappe's own permission check do the gating.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant`

**Purpose:** Edit an Applicant still at Draft or Registered. Does not change status — use
register_applicant for that transition.

Two special cases handled here rather than in Applicant.validate() (both need to run
*before* the normal update, and the entry_track one needs its own transition() call --
see CLAUDE.md's absolute "no doc.status = X; doc.save()" rule, state_machine.py):

1. entry_track changing while Registered/CV Generated forces a regression to Draft first
   (old track still in place, so the lenient Draft floor trivially passes), *then* the rest
   of the update (including the new entry_track) applies normally. cycle_number bumps
   automatically via state_machine.bump_cycle_number.
2. destination_country being set/changed is checked against Applicant Country Ban.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant_for_lmis`

**Purpose:** Narrow LMIS-stage edit surface (2026-08-29 correction, Part 5): national_id, labor_id,
and emergency_contact_* are deliberately NOT part of the Registered field floor -- they're
captured here, once the candidate is actually at the LMIS clearance step, not guessed at
registration time. Restricted to the two LMIS roles (plus Manager/Admin, same fallback
pattern as everywhere else) rather than general update_applicant.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.cv_api.generate_cv`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 3 / Part I Step 2: create + submit a CV Record for a Standard-track
Applicant, then move the Applicant to CV Generated. CV Record.validate() enforces the
Standard-only/Registered-status rules first (clearer, CV-specific error messages);
transition()'s own gate re-checks the same invariant as a backstop. The Musaned gate and
the musaned_status field were both removed 2026-08-29 -- Musaned tracking is gone from
this system entirely. Also renders and attaches the actual CV PDF (2026-08-29) --
previously this just created a bare record with no document output at all.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.list_my_wakala_requests`

**Purpose:** New (2026-08-29): a Contractor-scoped list of every unpaid Wakala-bearing Embassy step
for their own placements — the page the watchdog/manual reminders (watchdogs.
wakala_reminder_watchdog) are actually pointing them at. Mirrors list_my_clearance_steps()'s
pattern for the internal-staff side.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.list_portal_candidates`

**Purpose:** Part G: an agency sees only its own destination country's catalog — Standard-track
candidates that are CV Generated and not yet locked by anyone (active_placement empty).

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.select_candidate`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 4: atomic, globally exclusive selection. The instant one agency selects
a candidate, they vanish from every other agency's view — enforced here with a row lock
(SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so two concurrent selections can't both see the candidate as free.

free_replacement_for_complaint (Part A.4, Step 10): a worker who returned within the
3-month window entitles the same contractor to one free replacement selection. The
replacement "goes through the exact same journey from Stage 4 onward as any newly selected
candidate" (business-workflow-srs.md) — i.e. this same function — just flagged so
finance_engine.accrue_commission() skips billing for it.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.advance_placement`

**Purpose:** Move a Placement forward through its lifecycle via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part C). Passing override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked
(business-workflow-srs.md: "always with a written reason") — transition() itself enforces
the Manager/Admin role check and that the reason is non-empty.

This is the direct/manual path. The real auto-chain (LMIS -> Ticketing -> Departure,
corridor-completion gating Processing -> Stamped) is Step 7, once Clearance Step exists to
drive and gate against.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.create_muayena_placement`

**Purpose:** Muayena track (Part A.1 / Part I Step 4): "enters directly at Selected with contract in
hand" — no portal, no CV. Internal staff (Registrar/Manager/Admin/Contract Parser) only —
a Muayena candidate is matched to an agency directly, not through the public portal.

2026-08-29 correction: destination_country is no longer a parameter here. It used to be
set as a side effect of this call (the old assumption was that Muayena's destination
becomes known only once a contract names it); that was wrong — it's selected during
Draft/Registered same as Standard, and is now part of MUAYENA_REGISTERED_REQUIRED_FIELDS.
The contractor is always picked manually for Muayena (both countries) — Saudi's contract
*can* carry a labeled agency name/license for cross-checking, but auto-assignment isn't
attempted at creation time either way; Kuwait's contract never carries one at all.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.list_placements`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Placement never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Placement, which only Manager/Admin/System Manager/Contract
Parser/Ticketer could read (Placement's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role
that legitimately needs to resolve a placement reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer,
Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only
access on the doctype itself, see placement.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions
the same way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.parse_contract_file`

**Purpose:** Given a Frappe file_url for an uploaded contract, returns a dict of Placement field updates.
Extracts contract_signed_date, and country-specific structured fields.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.parse_visa_file`

**Purpose:** Kuwait visa document parser for placement_api.upload_visa.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_predeparture_medical_result`

**Purpose:** Pre-departure medical checkpoint (~72h before flight, Part A.2 Stage 8 / Step 6): gates
Ticketed -> Departed (see state_machine.medical_2_gate). Mirrors
record_selected_medical_result's shape -- FIT just records the result and lets
advance_placement(new_status="Departed") pass the gate; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant +
Placement via the same cascade, since a failed pre-departure medical this late (ticket
already purchased) has no forward path either, same as the earlier Selected-stage check.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_reschedule`

**Purpose:** Ticketer role. reschedule_cost is only meaningful/loggable when cause is Internal --
an airline/airport-caused reschedule isn't billed to us.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_selected_medical_result`

**Purpose:** New post-contract medical checkpoint (2026-08-29): gates Selected -> Processing (see
state_machine.medical_selected_gate). FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole
Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as applicant_api.cancel_applicant, uniformly
for every track/country -- nothing forward from here.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.record_ticket_details`

**Purpose:** Ticketer role. ticket_cost (if given) auto-logs a Pending Applicant Transaction expense
-- same pattern as clearance-step payments, everything money-related feeds the one Finance
ledger.

2026-08-30 fix (backend-issues #05): ticket_number/flight_date are pure logistics fields with
no FX dependency -- the cost-logging sub-step now runs inside its own DB savepoint, so a
missing FX rate for `currency` only unwinds the failed expense insert, not the ticket fields
saved just above (which is the doc.save() call still pending in the same transaction, same
as it always was -- only the failure boundary changed). The cost log is best-effort from
here on: failure is reported back to the caller as a warning, not a fatal error for the
whole call.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.upload_contract`

**Purpose:** Standard track (Part I Step 4): attach the signed contract to an already-selected
Placement (created by portal_api.select_candidate in Step 3) and extract contract_signed_date
plus, per destination_country, the structured fields contract_parser.parse_contract_file
knows how to pull out (Saudi: contract#/visa#/employer/agency; Kuwait: employer/site/
duration/salary only -- its template carries far less). Either the contractor who made the
selection, or internal staff (Contract Parser and the general fallback roles), may upload.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.upload_visa`

**Purpose:** Kuwait only: a separate document from the contract, uploaded alongside it. Carries
visa_number/type/dates plus the agency name/license the Kuwait contract itself never has.
Cross-checks the parsed agency identity against this Placement's actual Contractor and
flags a mismatch (notify, never auto-reassigns).

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.complete_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Mark a Clearance Step complete/Issued. Not for Embassy steps -- use
submit_embassy_step/stamp_embassy_step/reject_embassy_step instead.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.list_my_clearance_steps`

**Purpose:** A Clearance Officer / Ticketer's own ToDo-scoped queue, or -- for the six country+step
roles -- every row of their matching step_type. Driven entirely by the same permission
scoping as direct doctype access (Clearance Step's get_permission_query_conditions), so
this and a raw list call return the same rows.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.reassign_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Part A.2: "reassignable by a manager if needed" — the escape hatch for the default
auto-chain.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.reject_embassy_step`

**Purpose:** Documents returned rejected (Thursday) -- requires a written remark
(Clearance Step.validate() also enforces this as a backstop).

**Purpose:** Documents returned stamped (Thursday) -- the success outcome.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.start_clearance_step`

**Purpose:** Execute start_clearance_step

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.clearance_api.submit_embassy_step`

**Purpose:** Documents submitted (Monday). Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.approve_transaction`

**Purpose:** Finance Manager/Admin only. Moves Pending -> Approved via the sanctioned transition()
path -- only Approved entries count toward ledger/balance totals (Part D).

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Purpose:** Manual batching path (Part D: "both paths converge on one create_batch_request()
function" — the other path is the automatic one inside finance_engine.accrue_commission).

built fresh whenever requested, not pre-generated/stored at batch creation.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.get_fx_rate`

**Purpose:** Execute get_fx_rate

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.get_owed_commissions`

**Purpose:** Execute get_owed_commissions

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.log_stage_expense`

**Purpose:** Execute log_stage_expense

**Purpose:** Execute settle_batch

**Purpose:** AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): explicit multi-select manual settlement,

Batch Item child rows Paid and syncs each affected batch's status (Partially Settled until

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.trigger_early_commission_accrual`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.upload_batch_payment_proof`

**Purpose:** AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): parses a CSV or PDF listing paid applicant
names (best-effort), fuzzy-matches against this batch's own item list, marks matched items
Paid. Unmatched names stay Pending for manual settle_batch_items review -- never blocks.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.finance_api.void_transaction`

**Purpose:** No hard delete, ever (addendum). Finance Manager/Admin only, mandatory reason. Only
legal from Approved (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS enforces this — transition() itself rejects
voiding a Pending/Rejected row). Routed through transition() like every other status
change (never doc.status = X; doc.save() directly) -- the row stays visible with its
status flagged and a Process Event on the audit trail, never disappears.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.reconciliation_api.manually_match_line`

**Purpose:** Escape hatch for lines the automatic matcher couldn't confidently resolve (ambiguous
amount collisions, missing reference text) — Finance Manager/Admin only, same shape as
every other manual-override path in this build.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.reconciliation_api.upload_bank_statement`

**Purpose:** Execute upload_bank_statement

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.acknowledge_complaint`

**Purpose:** New -> Unresolved.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.create_complaint`

**Purpose:** business-workflow-srs.md Part 5: "Foreign agencies (or occasionally internal staff on
their behalf) can log a complaint against any worker." An agency can only complain about
their own placement; internal staff need some recognized staff role, but creation itself
isn't restricted the way resolution is.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.list_unresolved_complaints`

**Purpose:** business-workflow-srs.md Part 5: "sorted oldest-first so nothing quietly sits forgotten
at the bottom of a list."

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.complaint_api.resolve_complaint`

**Purpose:** Master spec Part A.5: "Only Complaint Manager and Admin can move resolution status."
Dismissed requires a written reason — enforced both here (clear error before the doctype
validate() would also catch it) and in Complaint.validate() as a defense-in-depth backstop.

override_reason (Manager Override, e.g. approving a free replacement outside the normal
3-month window in an exceptional case): overriding a gate is a Manager-level power
throughout this build (transition() itself enforces Manager/Admin for any override), so
the permission check here widens to include plain Manager specifically for an override
attempt — an ordinary (non-override) resolution move stays Complaint Manager/Admin only,
per Part A.5's literal statement.

**Active Role Context:** `Admin`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.chat_api.add_participant`

**Purpose:** addendum: "adding participants to an agency thread stays restricted" — enforced here as
an outright block for Agency threads (their shape is fixed at exactly two participants,
Chat Thread.validate() also enforces this). Internal threads can grow freely between staff.

**Purpose:** Execute get_csrf_token

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.auth_api.get_current_user`

**Purpose:** allow_guest=True deliberately, with an explicit Guest check inside — not a security
relaxation. Without it, an anonymous SPA's "is there already a session?" bootstrap check
(needed so a page refresh doesn't force a fresh login) hits Frappe's own whitelist guard
before this function's body ever runs, producing a 403 on every single cold page load.
Returning None for Guest instead of throwing means that bootstrap check is a normal 200
response either way — "nobody's logged in" is an expected outcome, not an error.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.cancel_applicant`

**Purpose:** Global 'Cancelled' escape hatch (2026-08-29 lifecycle spec): only from Registered/CV
Generated (never Draft -- nothing committed yet to cancel). If there's an active Placement,
freeze it and its Clearance Steps first (marked Cancelled, left as permanent history) and
clear active_placement -- all before the Applicant itself moves to Cancelled, so
Placement.validate()'s own checks (still-matching active_placement/status) pass cleanly.
Landing on Cancelled never bumps cycle_number by itself; only a later restart does.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.create_applicant`

**Purpose:** Open a new Applicant file at Draft. Registrar, Manager, Admin only
(doctype-level create permission, Part G).

**Purpose:** Execute get_applicant

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Applicant never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Applicant, which only Registrar/Manager/Admin/System Manager
could read (Applicant's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role that legitimately
needs to resolve an applicant name reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint
Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only access on
the doctype itself, see applicant.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions the same
way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.list_country_bans`

**Purpose:** Execute list_country_bans

**Purpose:** Manual 'Log Fee' button path. Just flips fee_status to Paid and saves -- the actual
ledger-entry creation lives in Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction (before_save), so a
direct Desk edit that sets fee_status=Paid gets identical behavior without going through
this endpoint at all. Kept as its own whitelisted call (rather than folding into
update_applicant) so the button can carry its own explicit permission + friendly
already-logged error, matching the other single-purpose action endpoints in this module.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.register_applicant`

**Purpose:** Move an Applicant from Draft to Registered via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part A.2 Stage 2). Field-floor and medical-FIT checks run inside Applicant.validate(),
triggered by transition()'s doc.save().

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.remove_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Delete permission on Applicant Country Ban is Manager/Admin/System Manager only (per
doctype permissions) -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.restart_applicant`

**Purpose:** Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically (lands on
Draft/Registered coming from Cancelled -- state_machine.bump_cycle_number). Restarting
straight to Registered fails naturally via the normal ValidationError from
Applicant.validate() if the field floor isn't actually satisfied by existing data --
retry with target_status="Draft" instead, no special-casing needed here.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.set_country_ban`

**Purpose:** Whitelisted create surface for Applicant Country Ban (backend-issues #08) -- the doctype
previously had no whitelisted writer anywhere, so the only way to set a ban was the raw
/api/resource/Applicant Country Ban endpoint, contradicting the "no raw /api/resource/*
exposure" architecture rule. Doctype permissions already grant create to Registrar/
Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager, so this just wraps a normal insert() and
lets Frappe's own permission check do the gating.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant`

**Purpose:** Edit an Applicant still at Draft or Registered. Does not change status — use
register_applicant for that transition.

Two special cases handled here rather than in Applicant.validate() (both need to run
*before* the normal update, and the entry_track one needs its own transition() call --
see CLAUDE.md's absolute "no doc.status = X; doc.save()" rule, state_machine.py):

1. entry_track changing while Registered/CV Generated forces a regression to Draft first
   (old track still in place, so the lenient Draft floor trivially passes), *then* the rest
   of the update (including the new entry_track) applies normally. cycle_number bumps
   automatically via state_machine.bump_cycle_number.
2. destination_country being set/changed is checked against Applicant Country Ban.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.applicant_api.update_applicant_for_lmis`

**Purpose:** Narrow LMIS-stage edit surface (2026-08-29 correction, Part 5): national_id, labor_id,
and emergency_contact_* are deliberately NOT part of the Registered field floor -- they're
captured here, once the candidate is actually at the LMIS clearance step, not guessed at
registration time. Restricted to the two LMIS roles (plus Manager/Admin, same fallback
pattern as everywhere else) rather than general update_applicant.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.cv_api.generate_cv`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 3 / Part I Step 2: create + submit a CV Record for a Standard-track
Applicant, then move the Applicant to CV Generated. CV Record.validate() enforces the
Standard-only/Registered-status rules first (clearer, CV-specific error messages);
transition()'s own gate re-checks the same invariant as a backstop. The Musaned gate and
the musaned_status field were both removed 2026-08-29 -- Musaned tracking is gone from
this system entirely. Also renders and attaches the actual CV PDF (2026-08-29) --
previously this just created a bare record with no document output at all.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Purpose:** New (2026-08-29): a Contractor-scoped list of every unpaid Wakala-bearing Embassy step
for their own placements — the page the watchdog/manual reminders (watchdogs.
wakala_reminder_watchdog) are actually pointing them at. Mirrors list_my_clearance_steps()'s
pattern for the internal-staff side.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.list_portal_candidates`

**Purpose:** Part G: an agency sees only its own destination country's catalog — Standard-track
candidates that are CV Generated and not yet locked by anyone (active_placement empty).

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.portal_api.select_candidate`

**Purpose:** Part A.2 Stage 4: atomic, globally exclusive selection. The instant one agency selects
a candidate, they vanish from every other agency's view — enforced here with a row lock
(SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so two concurrent selections can't both see the candidate as free.

free_replacement_for_complaint (Part A.4, Step 10): a worker who returned within the
3-month window entitles the same contractor to one free replacement selection. The
replacement "goes through the exact same journey from Stage 4 onward as any newly selected
candidate" (business-workflow-srs.md) — i.e. this same function — just flagged so
finance_engine.accrue_commission() skips billing for it.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.advance_placement`

**Purpose:** Move a Placement forward through its lifecycle via the sanctioned transition() path
(Part C). Passing override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked
(business-workflow-srs.md: "always with a written reason") — transition() itself enforces
the Manager/Admin role check and that the reason is non-empty.

This is the direct/manual path. The real auto-chain (LMIS -> Ticketing -> Departure,
corridor-completion gating Processing -> Stamped) is Step 7, once Clearance Step exists to
drive and gate against.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.create_muayena_placement`

**Purpose:** Muayena track (Part A.1 / Part I Step 4): "enters directly at Selected with contract in

a Muayena candidate is matched to an agency directly, not through the public portal.

2026-08-29 correction: destination_country is no longer a parameter here. It used to be
set as a side effect of this call (the old assumption was that Muayena's destination
becomes known only once a contract names it); that was wrong — it's selected during
Draft/Registered same as Standard, and is now part of MUAYENA_REGISTERED_REQUIRED_FIELDS.
The contractor is always picked manually for Muayena (both countries) — Saudi's contract
*can* carry a labeled agency name/license for cross-checking, but auto-assignment isn't
attempted at creation time either way; Kuwait's contract never carries one at all.

**Active Role Context:** `Manager`

**Function:** `agency_tracking.placement_api.list_placements`

**Purpose:** backend-issues #02: the whitelisted list surface Placement never had -- callers used to
fall back to raw /api/resource/Placement, which only Manager/Admin/System Manager/Contract
Parser/Ticketer could read (Placement's doctype-level permissions), 403ing every other role
that legitimately needs to resolve a placement reference (Finance Manager, Clearance Officer,
Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, the six country+step roles -- all granted read-only
access on the doctype itself, see placement.json). frappe.get_list enforces those permissions
the same way it would for any other doctype; no separate role check needed here.

record_selected_medical_result's shape -- FIT just records the result and lets
advance_placement(new_status="Departed") pass the gate; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant +

already purchased) has no forward path either, same as the earlier Selected-stage check.

missing FX rate for `currency` only unwinds the failed expense insert, not the ticket fields

as it always was -- only the failure boundary changed). The cost log is best-effort from

whole call.
